The '''Voss Orbital Docking Station''' was an Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
